scope: Dynamic uniaxial platen-compression regression with free lateral particle motion; numerical verification only, not experimental calibration.
interpretation_limits: The specimen is a simple-cubic bonded-sphere prism, not a cylindrical laboratory specimen.
Platens are infinite, frictionless planes with prescribed constant velocity.
Peak stress is a software benchmark output, not a calibrated ice compressive strength.
Particle resolution, loading-rate, boundary-condition and material-parameter convergence are not established by this case.
